_comment: ROUND 118/119: pre-existing cancelled-load money-artifact violations, measured BEFORE this guard existed -- these loads were cancelled before dispatch/cancellation.service.ts's cascade covered every family (or before the vendor-bill linkage/cascade existed at all). Shrink-only: a key leaves when its violation is fixed by hand or a future cascade re-run; a NEW key (a load cancelled AFTER this guard existed still leaving live money) fails the guard -- that would be a real regression, never baselined.
